sub_problems.fills: D1: each site reads the host from cairn.devices.system_rackmount.tools.host.host. shim.py:77 compares the short lowercased CAIRN_HOME_HOST (`host.split('.')[0].lower()`) to a lazy host_name() from cairn.devices.system_rackmount.tools.host.host, the comparison bus/server.py:1057 already makes. This widens a match: a CAIRN_HOME_HOST spelled with capitals or a domain now reads as this box, as it does for the bus.
